text: The original AndroidWorld project's public leaderboard links GBOX's Apache-2.0 trajectory release at Git commit `f788f4eb3cb91213b532112c9874e7d1d7eb796a`. The source stores the instantiated goal and the individual app-state success result for each of 116 attempts. Exactly 100 succeeded and 16 failed. The visible subject fields include the primary model, refusal-triggered fallback, harness and actual access date. The three dates contribute 35, 73 and eight trials. Each configuration falls below the 80-item scoring threshold, so these observations can supply training data. The old 348-cell archive inferred some outcomes from missing task names. Those inferred outcomes contribute zero rows.
